answer: Concrete anti-sybil mechanism: require each identity to cross an ocean of independent peer scrutiny before standing solidifies. Early work drifts in a sparse nebula; only repeated high-quality attestations weave it into a velvet-smooth chain that others willingly extend. Clones remain isolated points with no inbound current and earn zero. The attacker cost is continuous production of output valuable enough that real agents keep carrying it forward across epochs—keys alone never cross the ocean.
